from __future__ import annotations

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank, delta
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


@register_factor
class HighVolumePriceMovement(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "high_volume_price_movement"
    name = "High Volume Price Movement"
    category = "momentum"
    description = ("This signal computes the ratio of the price change (close - open) to the volume for each bar, focusing on significant price movements with high volume. It identifies potential momentum trades based on the strength of conviction in price changes.")
    inputs = ["open", "close", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6  # bars ahead the edge peaks
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_price = data["open"]
        close_price = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        # Calculate price change
        price_change = close_price - open_price

        # Calculate the ratio of price change to volume
        price_movement_signal = price_change / volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        # Rank the signal across the cross-section
        return rank(price_movement_signal)

import numpy as np

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank, delta, ts_mean, stddev
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


@register_factor
class HighVolumePriceMomentumV2(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "high_volume_price_momentum_v2"
    name = "High Volume Price Momentum v2"
    category = "momentum"
    description = ("This signal computes the ratio of the price change (close - open) to the average volume over the last few bars, adjusted for recent price volatility.")
    inputs = ["open", "close", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6  # bars ahead the edge peaks
    suggested_horizons = [6]

        close_price = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"].replace(0.0, np.nan)

        # Calculate price change
        price_change = close_price - open_price

        # Calculate the rolling average of volume over the last 5 bars
        avg_volume = ts_mean(volume, 5)

        # Calculate the rolling standard deviation of price changes over the last 5 bars (volatility)
        price_volatility = stddev(price_change, 5)

        # Rank the signal across the cross-section
        return rank(price_movement_signal)

from __future__ import annotations  
import pandas as pd  
import numpy as np  
from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor  
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank, delta, ts_mean  
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor  

@register_factor  
class HighVolumePriceMomentumV3(BaseFactor):  
    factor_id = "high_volume_price_momentum_v3"  
    name = "High Volume Price Momentum v3"  
    category = "momentum"  
    description = ("This signal computes the rate of change of price (close - open) normalized by the average volume over a specified period, focusing on significant price movements supported by high volume.")  
    inputs = ["open", "close", "volume"]  
    prediction_horizon = 6  
    suggested_horizons = [6]  

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:  
        open_price = data["open"]  
        close_price = data["close"]  
        volume = data["volume"]  

        # Calculate price change  
        price_change = close_price - open_price  

        # Calculate the average volume over the last 5 bars  
        avg_volume = ts_mean(volume, 5).replace(0.0, np.nan)  

        # Calculate the rate of change of price normalized by average volume  
        price_movement_signal = delta(close_price, 1) / avg_volume  

        # Rank the signal across the cross-section  
        return rank(price_movement_signal)
